user.description:
Connect Home Assistant to your Tandoor Recipes instance.

1. In Tandoor, click your user avatar (top right) → **Settings** → tab **API**
2. Create a **new token** with scope `read write` and copy it (`tda_...`)
3. Enter your Tandoor URL and the token below

data_description.url: The address of your Tandoor instance as you open it in the browser, e.g. http://192.168.1.4:9926
data_description.api_token: The API token created in Tandoor under Settings → API (scope read write)

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Tandoor. Check the URL.

abort.already_configured: This Tandoor instance is already configured.

init.description: Optional: connect the Kochliste (cooking backlog) of the Essensplan website. Leave the URL empty to disable the feature.

data_description.essensplan_url: Base URL of the Essensplan website, e.g. http://192.168.1.4:8091. Empty = Kochliste disabled.

kochliste_gekocht.name: Kochliste: mark as cooked
kochliste_gekocht.description: Marks a Kochliste recipe as cooked (also creates today's meal plan entry in Tandoor).

id.name: Kochliste ID
id.description: The Kochliste item ID, e.g. k7 (see the rezepte attribute of the Kochliste sensor).

kochliste_kochbar.name: Kochliste: mark as cookable
kochliste_kochbar.description: Moves a Kochliste recipe from 'shopping needed' to 'cookable'.

id.name: Kochliste ID
id.description: The Kochliste item ID, e.g. k7 (see the rezepte attribute of the Kochliste sensor).

kochliste_bewerten.name: Kochliste: rate recipe
kochliste_bewerten.description: Rates a Tandoor recipe with 0-5 stars and an optional comment (0 = remove rating).

sterne.name: Stars
sterne.description: Rating from 0 to 5 stars (0 removes the rating).

kommentar.name: Comment
kommentar.description: Optional comment for the cook log.
